sat mārge sthiratām gataḥ ham aniśam bhoḥ pāvane smin kalā pūrṇaḥ anugrahataḥ tava a vikalataḥ dhvastāḥ samasta āpadaḥ

original: nirveighno'jani padminīpariṇayo yogīndrasaṃsevitasvāmin dhairyajitākṣa nātha bhagavansarvaṃ mayāptaṃ śubham ||
analyzed: padminī pariṇayaḥ yogi indra saṃsevita svāmin dhairya jita akṣa nātha bhagavan sarvam mayā āptam śubham
tathā api idam astuḥ bharata vākyam
bhūdevāḥ vilasantu sat vidhi ratāḥ nityam
rājānaḥ pṛthivī sura arcana parāḥ jīvantu santaḥ ciram

original: nandantvatra parāḥ prajāśca paśavo bhūrastu sasyojjvalā
analyzed: nandantu atra parāḥ prajāḥ ca paśavaḥ bhūḥ astu sasya ujjvalā
bhaktiḥ sundara rāja sūri hṛdaye rāmasya saṃvardhatām
